candidates.title: Prepare invoice fields for school review

demandEvidence.chore: Handle invoices and prepare financial materials for budget follow-up.
demandEvidence.evidenceQuote: hantera fakturor och ta fram ekonomiska underlag för budget och uppföljning

ease.reason: A synthetic invoice test is approachable; the template documents PDF extraction and Sheets logging, but school-specific fields are unknown.

profit.reason: Hypothesis: school offices may value a review aid; the vacancy establishes human work, not AI-service demand.

feasibility.reason: A two-week mock can extract a few operator-chosen fields from fictional invoices; the template does not establish budget rules or school access.

autonomy.reason: The template describes extraction and sheet logging; a clerk must verify every field and handle budget decisions.

evidence.reason: The paid notice names invoice handling; the template describes invoice PDF extraction and sheet logging, not school use.

candidates.reason: A bounded fictional-invoice extraction and logging mock is assessable using the attached template, but school-specific fields and rules are absent. The five ratings average 4.6, below the threshold of 6; no AI-service demand is established.

rejected.title: Assess general school administration duties
rejected.reason: The fresh notice describes a school administrator role and workplace qualities but no concrete chore; proposing a specific workflow would invent demand.

rejected.title: Assess unspecified school administrator duties
rejected.reason: The fresh notice contains only a role label and date, with no concrete task to assess; a useful prototype would require invented duties.

rejected.title: Assess broad school support duties
rejected.reason: The notice describes broad administrative support and collaboration without a bounded task; it does not support an honest narrow experiment.
